body:
For reasons I don't entirely understand, adding `/bin/bash -c` makes it print, e.g.,

```
# Prints nothing
ctx.execute(['echo "hi"''], quiet = False)
# Prints 'hi'
ctx.execute(["/bin/bash", "-c", 'echo "hi"'], quiet = False)
```

Adding @ulfjack, who last changed the output handling.

Hi,
Any news?

issue.title: Bazel query //... downloads 1.1 GB zip file and then hangs

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
The hang might be due to #3534. But having Bazel query download a 1 GB zip file _on every single run_ with no caching seems like a pretty bad user experience.

```
$ bazel query //...
...
INFO: Downloading https://github.com/google/j2objc/releases/download/2.0.3/j2o\
bjc-2.0.3.zip via github-production-release-asset-2e65be.s3.amazonaws.com: 101\
,159,424 bytes
```
